ety.text: From Proto-Italic *-ðō, from Proto-Indo-European *dʰeh₁- (“put; do”). This is also the root of faciō, see the Related terms section. The regular outcomes of *dʰ in Latin are /f/ word-initially (cf. fūmus) and /d/ otherwise (cf. fīdō). The derivatives of -dō are not always easy to distinguish from those of dō (“give”) < *deh₃-.
